notes.title: Cavern of Dreams - Patch v7.4 now live 🐉
notes.content:
Hello!

Patch 7.4 for Cavern of Dreams is live! Your continued support has been amazing, and we can't wait for you to jump into the new patch. The changes are:

[list]
[*] Fixed achievements sometimes not unlocking or unlocking late
[*] Fixed bug where player has to close & open game after beating final boss in order to refight them in subsequent playthroughs
[*] Update Tutorials/Control menus dialog to show based on which controller is being used (keyboard, controller, Steamdeck)
[*] Moved Jump & Interact tutorial triggers to avoid overwhelming UI
[*] Improved timing of Tail Spin unlock cutscene
[*] Updated some dialog to fix grammar errors
[*] Improved quality of some of the egg hints
[*] Undead monsters no longer become peaceful when hit
[*] Minor graphical improvements to Prismic Palace, Gallery of Nightmares, encyclopedia
[/list]
The majority of the feedback we gathered from our discord community, join here 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/RWxZSvCD5x]https://discord.gg/RWxZSvCD5x[/url]

Enjoy!
- Bynine

notes.title: Cavern of Dreams - Patch v7.3 now live 🐉
notes.content:
Hello!
Here are the latest updates for Cavern of Dreams in this recent patch. Thanks for all your support so far and the immense amount of positivity towards the game!
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where players who quit after unlocking the final challenge but before completing it would be unable to complete the game. Save files affected by this will now work as intended.
[*] Player's chosen options are retained after saving & quitting
[*] Skritch’s hitboxes have been nerfed
[*] Removed two tapestries inside Prismic Palace
[*] Fixed bubble challenge inside Prismic Palace
[*] Added Bubble Conch to the racetrack in Prismic Palace, so players don’t have to backtrack to get a new one
[*] Made hint about the Grimy Gloves more helpful
[*] Fixed audio levels in Lostleaf Lake and Prismic Palace so the music is clearer
[*] Updated theme inside Airborne Armada
[*] Fixed Steam Cloud Support
[/list]
The majority of the feedback we gathered from our discord community, join here 👇
[url=https://discord.gg/RWxZSvCD5x]https://discord.gg/RWxZSvCD5x[/url]
Enjoy!
- Bynine

notes.title: CAVERN OF DREAMS IS OUT NOW! 🐲
notes.content:
[h2]Cavern of Dreams is now live on Steam! 🐲 [/h2]

Embark on a magical quest as Fynn the dragon to rescue your unhatched siblings from the mysterious Cavern of Dreams in this N64-style 3D platformer. Gain new abilities, meet unique characters, solve puzzles, and beware of the mysterious villain.

Thank you for all of our support throughout this journey of development. Good luck traversing through the [i]Cavern of Dreammmmssssss[/i]!!!

[h3]Get your copy of Cavern of Dreams now 👇[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059660/Cavern_of_Dreams/
